prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Adoption Personality Matrix Stage: Redesign the friend selection screen into an interactive personality matrix grid with live trait radar charts and direct pet voice previews. (why: Adoption step has the highest drop-off rate (72.3%) and long completion times, indicating users struggle to evaluate and commit to pet choices.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Pet Spawn Zone Playground Screen: Introduce a new interactive desktop positioning preview screen (new_desktop_spawn_zone) right before the waiting phase so users choose where their pet first appears on screen. (why: Home step has a high mean duration (2336s) and support emails report pets not showing up on desktop or users feeling confused on initial appearance.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Tray Command Sandbox Flow: Transform the final onboarding step into an active sandbox where users test desktop pet commands, hiding/showing controls, and system tray shortcuts. (why: Support received multiple tickets regarding post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
3: [home, wait_info] Background Generation Activity Progress Log: Display a multi-stage background asset assembly timeline with detailed status updates on the waiting screen. (why: The home waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s; clear visual milestone indicators reduce anxiety during long rendering times.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Instant Preset vs Custom Pet Expectation Header: Clarify path selection headlines with explicit setup time expectations (e.g. 30-second Preset vs Custom AI Generation). (why: choose_path has a mean duration of 514s, showing users spend considerable time deliberating without clear duration expectations.)
5: [sign_in, incentive] Account Cloud Recovery Sync Guarantee Badge: Add an explicit Cloud Pet Recovery Guarantee badge on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signed-in pets will never reset or get lost. (why: Support received 8 emails specifically regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
6: [finish, hint] Desktop Control Hotkeys Quick Cheat Sheet: Add a persistent desktop hotkey visual cheat sheet component to the final home_intro screen detailing hide, call, and settings hotkeys. (why: Support tickets report user confusion on how to recall or hide the pet once desktop setup completes.)
7: [home, notification] App Ready Desktop Audio Chime & Notification Switch: Enable desktop audio chime and background readiness system alerts on the waiting screen so users know when rendering finishes if minimized. (why: Home step waiting time mean is 2336 seconds, indicating users minimize the app and forget about it during background rendering.)
